description: This file contains unit tests for the AbstractVertxBasedHttpProtocolAdapter class, verifying its behavior in various scenarios such as startup, message handling, error conditions, and tenant configuration within a Vert.x environment.

classes.name: AbstractVertxBasedHttpProtocolAdapterTest
classes.description: Test class for the behavior of AbstractVertxBasedHttpProtocolAdapter, utilizing Vert.x testing facilities and Mockito for mocking dependencies.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes common test fixtures and mocks dependencies before each test.

methods.name: testStartUsesClientProvidedHttpServer
methods.description: Verifies that the adapter uses a provided HTTP server instead of creating a new one during startup.

methods.name: testStartInvokesOnStartupSuccess
methods.description: Checks that onStartupSuccess callback is invoked after successful server start.

methods.name: testStartDoesNotInvokeOnStartupSuccessIfStartupFails
methods.description: Ensures onStartupSuccess is not called if server startup fails.

methods.name: testUploadTelemetryFailsForDisabledTenant
methods.description: Verifies that telemetry upload fails with 403 if the tenant disables the adapter.

methods.name: testUploadTelemetryFailsForUnknownDevice
methods.description: Checks that unregistered devices get a 404 response when attempting telemetry upload.

methods.name: testUploadEventWaitsForAcceptedOutcome
methods.description: Ensures that event upload delays response until downstream acknowledges acceptance.

methods.name: testUploadEventFailsForRejectedOutcome
methods.description: Verifies that rejected events receive a 400 response.

methods.name: testUploadEventWithTimeToLive
methods.description: Checks that event messages include the correct TTL from headers.

methods.name: testUploadCommandResponseWaitsForAcceptedOutcome
methods.description: Verifies command response processing delays reply until downstream accepts.

methods.name: testUploadCommandResponseFailsForDisabledTenant
methods.description: Ensures command responses from disabled tenants result in 403.

methods.name: testUploadCommandResponseFailsForNonExistingDevice
methods.description: Checks that non-registered devices receive 404 on command response upload.

methods.name: testUploadCommandResponseFailsForRejectedOutcome
methods.description: Verifies that rejected command responses get a 400 reply.

methods.name: testUploadTelemetryDoesNotWaitForAcceptedOutcome
methods.description: Ensures telemetry messages are responded to with 202 immediately without waiting for downstream.

methods.name: testUploadTelemetryRemovesTtdIfCommandConsumerIsInUse
methods.description: Checks that TTD header is removed if command consumer is already in use.

methods.name: testUploadTelemetryWithTtdClosesCommandConsumerIfSenderCreationFailed
methods.description: Verifies cleanup behavior when telemetry sender creation fails mid-processing.

methods.name: testIsGatewayMappingEnabled
methods.description: Tests behavior of isGatewayMappingEnabled based on tenant configuration.

methods.name: testUploadTelemetryWithDisabledGatewayMapping
methods.description: Ensures correct handling of gateway mapping logic during telemetry upload with tenant settings.

methods.name: testUploadEmptyNotificationSucceedsIfCommandConsumerIsInUse
methods.description: Checks that empty notifications are accepted if command consumer is busy.

methods.name: testUploadTelemetryUsesConfiguredMaxTtd
methods.description: Verifies that the maximum TTD configured for tenant overrides device provided TTD.

methods.name: testMessageLimitExceededForATelemetryMessage
methods.description: Tests rejection of telemetry message when message limit is exceeded.

methods.name: testMessageLimitExceededForAnEventMessage
methods.description: Tests rejection of event message when limit is exceeded.

methods.name: testMessageLimitExceededForACommandResponseMessage
methods.description: Tests rejection of command response message when message limit is exceeded.
